Solar Installer

Riverside, CA

Full-time

Join Solar CCS

Solar CCS is hiring a Solar Installer to install photovoltaic systems safely and accurately. You will prepare work areas, assemble racking, mount modules, route conductors, and support electrical tie-ins under the direction of licensed professionals. The role requires careful use of hand and power tools, daily attention to fall protection, and respectful communication with homeowners and crew members.

Applicants should be comfortable working outdoors, lifting materials, reading plans, maintaining a clean jobsite, and following OSHA procedures. This full-time role is based in Riverside, CA and may travel to nearby projects in Southern California. Compensation is $24 - $32 per hour depending on relevant experience, licenses, and demonstrated installation skills.
